parsed.rationale: Very deep S waves in V1-V3 (about 25 mm) plus tall R waves in V5-V6 meet voltage criteria for LVH, with a narrow QRS and a strain pattern (ST depression and T inversion) in V5-V6. The concave ST elevation in V1-V3 is the expected discordant change of LVH and does not meet STEMI criteria.
